item.title: Amended EUDR regulation to exclude books
item.description: Today the European Parliament plenary voted in favour of the provisional agreement reached with the Council on the EUDR-amending Regulation. This means ‘printed books, newspapers, pictures and other products of the printing industry, manuscripts, typescripts and plans, of paper’ have been exempted from the EUDR.
